top_strengths.name: Communicator
top_strengths.meaningful_use: Ensures shared understanding by summarizing clearly, choosing precise words, and aligning interpretations.
top_strengths.counterbalance: Pause and ask what the other person actually needs to know.

top_strengths.name: Examiner
top_strengths.meaningful_use: Safeguards quality by verifying information, catching inconsistencies, and spotting risks early.
top_strengths.overuse_risk: May overcheck and drift into perfectionism.
top_strengths.counterbalance: Define the required accuracy level in advance.

top_strengths.name: Inventor
top_strengths.meaningful_use: Creates novelty by generating original solutions, connecting ideas, and running experiments.
top_strengths.overuse_risk: May open too many ideas at once and hurt delivery.
top_strengths.counterbalance: Limit experiments and tie them to current priorities.

top_strengths.name: Learner
top_strengths.meaningful_use: Improves through feedback, reflection, and repeated practice.

top_strengths.name: Decision Maker
top_strengths.meaningful_use: Mobilizes commitment by naming decisions, choosing direction, and clarifying ownership and next steps.

unrealised_strengths.name: Motivator
unrealised_strengths.meaning: Lifts energy, momentum, and morale when engagement drops.

unrealised_strengths.name: Networker
unrealised_strengths.meaning: Builds connections by initiating contact, staying visible, and creating useful relationships.

unrealised_strengths.name: Facilitator
unrealised_strengths.meaning: Enables participation and alignment by helping groups include voices, work through tension, and adapt together.
